messages:
Tara Nguyen: Quick thought - we should add a 'requant sanity' lint that runs when a profile switches an operator from int8 -> fp8 or 4bit -> int8. catches accidental regressions early.
Diego Morales: +1. What checks do you propose? smoke logits/hash compare or full anchor eval?
Tara Nguyen: lightweight first: token-topk-hash delta (CI smoke). if that flags, trigger extended anchors and block merge until ML review.
Hannah Brooks: For runtime safety, add a canary preflight: when new profile is loaded into shard, run N synthetic in-memory passes (no network) for critical ops to validate numeric stability. cheap and fast.
Diego Morales: good idea. N=5 with jittered seeds should expose numeric flakiness. also check output variance and KL on top-k distributions.
Tara Nguyen: lint rules: 1) disallow lowering precision for ops with safety_critical flag unless two approvers. 2) require fallback_chain contains a strictly higher-precision step. 3) attach expected anchor id list to profile so CI can auto-run relevant anchors.
Hannah Brooks: runtime enforcement: profile load-time verifies lint. If lint fails, reject apply. For canary applies, run in-shadow for 1000 requests or 0.1% traffic (whichever smaller) before committing.
Diego Morales: telemetry: emit 'requant_sanity' short report after load: {profile_id, checks:[topk_failures, variance_ms, failed_ops]} — keep it compact.
Tara Nguyen: small proto sketch for lint output: 
```
status: FAIL
reasons: ["op=attn.proj:topk_hash_mismatch", "op=ffn.w1:variance>thresh"]
blocking: true
```
(Hopefully simple to parse by CI)
Hannah Brooks: ops-bot: can you create a checklist ticket for Requant Lint + Canary Preflight?
ops-bot: Created ML-4622: "Requant lint + shard preflight canary" assigned to Tara Nguyen, Diego Morales, Hannah Brooks. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-4622 :white_check_mark:
Diego Morales: Action items: Diego -> implement topk-hash comparator in eval lib. Tara -> author lint rules and CI hooks. Hannah -> prototype in-shard synthetic preflight runner.
Tara Nguyen: timeline: aim for CI smoke by EOW, in-shard preflight PoC next sprint.
Hannah Brooks: Also add a safety net: if preflight shows ops failing, auto-apply fallback for those ops (move to next fallback) and mark profile as 'mutated-by-runtime' for audit.
Diego Morales: agree. runtime should be allowed to nudge profile only to immediate-safe fallback and must record mutation event.
Tara Nguyen: perfect. i'll update ML-4622 with lint spec and example anchors. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
